description: Source code implementing SPI and I2S firmware functions for STM32F10x microcontrollers, including initialization, configuration, data transfer, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the SPIx peripheral registers to their default reset values.

methods.name: SPI_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SPIx peripheral with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: I2S_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SPIx peripheral in I2S mode with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: SPI_StructInit
methods.description: Fills SPI_InitTypeDef structure with default values.

methods.name: I2S_StructInit
methods.description: Fills I2S_InitTypeDef structure with default values.

methods.name: SPI_Cmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified SPI peripheral.

methods.name: I2S_Cmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified SPI in I2S mode.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_ITConfig
methods.description: Configures the specified SPI/I2S interrupt.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_DMACmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified SPI/I2S DMA requests.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_SendData
methods.description: Transmits data through SPI/I2S.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from SPI/I2S.

methods.name: SPI_NSSInternalSoftwareConfig
methods.description: Configures NSS pin internally via software.

methods.name: SPI_SSOutputCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the SS output for SPI.

methods.name: SPI_DataSizeConfig
methods.description: Configures data size for SPI.

methods.name: SPI_TransmitCRC
methods.description: Transmits CRC value.

methods.name: SPI_CalculateCRC
methods.description: Enables or disables CRC calculation.

methods.name: SPI_GetCRC
methods.description: Returns CRC register value.

methods.name: SPI_GetCRCPolynomial
methods.description: Returns CRC polynomial register value.

methods.name: SPI_BiDirectionalLineConfig
methods.description: Configures data transfer direction in bi-directional mode.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks whether a specific SPI/I2S flag is set.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_ClearFlag
methods.description: Clears specific SPI CRC error flag.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_GetITStatus
methods.description: Checks whether a specific SPI/I2S interrupt has occurred.

methods.name: SPI_I2S_ClearITPendingBit
methods.description: Clears SPI/I2S interrupt pending bits.
